name: gorjeta-77-lukas
description: Gorjeta 77 Lukas - sistema publico de cadastro e sorteios com animacao cinematografica

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.netlify:ci: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --include=dev --prefix server --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --include=dev --prefix web --no-audit --no-fund && npm run netlify:build
